newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume up on lower prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume up on lower prices.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange saw lively morning activity on Tuesday with 1,080 kilos traded, followed by a quiet afternoon with only 130 kilos traded.
Gold prices eased to $379.35 an ounce and 1,213,515 lira per gram, from Monday's $379.70 and 1,214,100 lira.
Dealers said the jump in morning volume was due to buyers rushing to continue to benefit from the lower prices after a similarly busy session on Monday afternoon.
Of the total turnover 51 percent was in lira terms.
The drop in gold prices in lira terms was less as the lira remained weak against the dollar on continuing bank demand for the U.S. currency.
It ended at 99,325 to the dollar versus Monday's 99,260 despite minor central bank intervention, heavy cash demand and a lower dollar/mark parity.
